title: Integral, rational, and algebraically closed compact-support functors
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $K_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism. Fix a prime $\ell$, write
$\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], choose an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and
require that $\ell$ is invertible in $K_0$. Choose a finite extension
$E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a uniformizer $\varpi_E$. For
every $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, set $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, with reduction maps $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. The
categories $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$, $D^b_c(X,E)$, and $D^b_c(X,\Qlb)$ use,
respectively, the derived-complete integral
[def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], rationalized
[def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and common-stage algebraically closed
[def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] constructions. The finite levels
use finite-torsion constructibility
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Choose a compactification $c=(j,\bar f)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], the same for all $n$, and let $Rf_{!,n}=Rf^{c}_{!,n}=R\bar f_{*,n}\,j_!:D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ be the finite-level compact-support direct image attached to $c$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal
O_E)$, put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$, the derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $\operatorname{Res}_n:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be the restriction of scalars of the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], applied termwise (it is exact [lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact]). The objects $\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{!,n}K_n$ form an inverse system in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$: the transition map $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}Rf_{!,n+1}K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{!,n}K_n$ is $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}$ of $Rf_{!,n+1}$ applied to the reduction map $K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}^{A_{E,n+1}}_{A_{E,n}}K_n$ (induced on K-flat representatives by $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$), followed by the isomorphism $Rf_{!,n+1}\operatorname{Res}^{A_{E,n+1}}_{A_{E,n}}\cong\operatorname{Res}^{A_{E,n+1}}_{A_{E,n}}Rf_{!,n}$ [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] and the equality $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}\operatorname{Res}^{A_{E,n+1}}_{A_{E,n}}=\operatorname{Res}_n$. Define

$$
 Rf_!K=
 R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{!,n}K_n,
$$

the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] of this system in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, which exists because countable products of pro-etale module sheaves are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence]. It lies in $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible]. This is the integral form of the compactification-independent direct image
[def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. If $K_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ is
represented by $K$ (the objects of $D^b_c(X,E)$ are those of $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$), define

$$
 Rf_!K_E=(Rf_!K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}^L E,
$$

the object $Rf_!K$ of $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ regarded as an object of the rationalized category $D^b_c(Y,E)=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$. If $K_{\Qlb}\in D^b_c(X,\Qlb)$ is represented
at a finite stage by $K_E$ for some $E\subset\Qlb$ in the directed set of finite subextensions [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], that is $K_{\Qlb}=(E,K_E)$, define

$$
 Rf_!K_{\Qlb}=Rf_!K_E\otimes_E\Qlb,
$$

the object $(E,Rf_!K_E)$ of the common-stage category $D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$. Independence of the integral representative, of the finite stage $E$, and of the compactification $c$ are separate statements, not part of this definition.

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint node (order 1490; no slopmaster2 Lean, no separate slopmaster2 text) and Bhatt-Scholze Def. 6.7.6/Lemma 6.7.7. Mathematics unchanged; the statement now names every notion it is built from, following the pattern of the sibling def-weil-derived-direct-image: the l-adic numbers, algebraic closure and coefficient rings A_{E,n} with their reductions; a chosen compactification (def-weil-compactifications-refinements), fixed for all n, and the finite-level Rf_{!,n}^c (def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed); the derived reduction K_n (def-weil-integral-derived-reduction); Res_n and its exactness (def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact); the tower maps, which the blueprint did not write, built from the reduction maps and the new lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars (Rf^c_! commutes with restriction of scalars along A_{E,n+1}->A_{E,n}); the Roos-triangle derived limit and its existence (def-weil-derived-limit, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence, lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact); and the fact, needed for the rational and Qlbar constructions to make sense, that Rf_!K lies in D^b_c(Y,O_E) (new lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible, BS 6.7.7 and Stacks 0GL0). The rational and Qlbar values are now said explicitly to be the object Rf_!K of the rationalization (same objects) and the pair (E,Rf_!K_E) of the common-stage category (def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set added). Corrected 'its image in K_0' (of Qlbar) to 'l is invertible in K_0'. Mathlib has the pro-etale site only; searches recorded.
